source.title: Open problems in the theory of fuzzy metric spaces

accepted.question_text: Let CFM be the set of isometry classes of compact fuzzy metric spaces, where a fuzzy metric space is a triple (X, M, *) consisting of a set X, a continuous t-norm * on [0,1], and a function M on X^2 × (0,∞) satisfying positivity, identity of indiscernibles, symmetry, a triangle-type inequality M(x,y,t) * M(y,z,s) ≤ M(x,z,t+s), and continuity in the time variable. When CFM is endowed with the fuzzy Gromov-Hausdorff metric, is CFM a separable fuzzy metric space?
accepted.context_brief: Separability of the fuzzy Gromov-Hausdorff space of compact fuzzy metric spaces.

evidence.quote: 2. Questions. Denote by CFM the set of isometry classes of compact fuzzy metric spaces endowed with the fuzzy Gromov-Hausdorff metric. Question 1. Is the space CFM separable?

accepted.question_text: With CFM denoting the fuzzy metric space of isometry classes of compact fuzzy metric spaces endowed with the fuzzy Gromov-Hausdorff metric, is CFM completable, and can the elements of such a completion be described naturally as complete separable fuzzy metric spaces?
accepted.context_brief: Completion of the fuzzy Gromov-Hausdorff space CFM.

evidence.quote: One can also conjecture that the fuzzy metric space CFM is completable (note that there are noncompletable fuzzy metric spaces [3]) and the elements of its completion can be naturally described as complete separable fuzzy metric spaces.

accepted.question_text: Is the collection of finite fuzzy metric spaces dense, with respect to the fuzzy Gromov-Hausdorff metric, in CFM, the space of isometry classes of compact fuzzy metric spaces?
accepted.context_brief: Density of finite fuzzy metric spaces in CFM.

evidence.quote: Question 2. Is the space of finite fuzzy metric spaces dense in CFM?

accepted.question_text: A compact fuzzy metric-measure space is a quadruple (X, M, *, μ) in which (X, M, *) is a compact fuzzy metric space and μ is a probability measure on X. If one equips the class of all compact fuzzy metric-measure spaces with the fuzzy Gromov-Prokhorov distance M_GP defined via isometric embeddings into a common fuzzy metric space, is the resulting fuzzy metric space separable?
accepted.context_brief: Separability of the fuzzy Gromov-Prokhorov space of compact fuzzy mm-spaces.

evidence.quote: A compact fuzzy mm-space is a quadruple (X, M, ∗, µ), where (X, M, ∗) is a compact fuzzy metric space and µ is a probability measure on X. ... Question 3. Is the obtained fuzzy metric space of all compact fuzzy mm-spaces separable? Is it completable?

accepted.question_text: For the fuzzy metric space of all compact fuzzy metric-measure spaces, equipped with the fuzzy Gromov-Prokhorov distance M_GP defined from the Prokhorov fuzzy metric on probability measures and common isometric embeddings into a fuzzy metric space, is that fuzzy metric space completable?
accepted.context_brief: Completeness/completion of the fuzzy Gromov-Prokhorov space of compact fuzzy mm-spaces.

evidence.quote: Question 3. Is the obtained fuzzy metric space of all compact fuzzy mm-spaces separable? Is it completable?

accepted.question_text: In the setting of compact fuzzy metric-measure spaces and probability measures on fuzzy metric spaces, can one define fuzzy counterparts of the Kantorovich metric and of Gromov's λ-metric, analogous to the metrics used in the theory of metric-measure spaces?
accepted.context_brief: Fuzzy analogues of Kantorovich and Gromov λ metrics.

evidence.quote: In the theory of mm-spaces, various metrics on the set of probability measures on a metric space are considered. Here, we mention only two examples: the Kantorovich metric (and its generalizations) [6] and the Gromov λ-metric [4, Chapter 3 1/2]. It is an open question to define counterparts of these metrics in the fuzzy setting.

needs_review.question_text_raw: Similar questions can be formulated for some classes of fuzzy metric spaces, e.g., for stationary fuzzy metric spaces.

evidence.quote: Similar questions can be formulated for some classes of fuzzy metric spaces, e.g., for stationary fuzzy metric spaces.

needs_review.question_text_raw: Nothing is known on the geometry of the fuzzy metric space of all compact fuzzy mm-spaces.

evidence.quote: Nothing is known on the geometry of the fuzzy metric space of all compact fuzzy mm-spaces.
